title: Successor cycles map is epic
statement: With an abelian category C, a cochain complex K, a decreasing filtration F, r >= 1, page differential data D, a bidegree pq, and the inclusion hZ of graded successor cycles into graded r-cycles, every map f from graded successor cycles to the kernel whose composite with the kernel inclusion is hZ followed by the page quotient is an epimorphism.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle, boundary and differential formulas and lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex

proof.text: Use filteredComplex_differential_representatives_cover at i=pq and j=pq+(r,1-r), obtaining an epic x and simultaneous representatives t,tprime,x,y. The composite x followed by the page cokernel projection is epic. Pull it back along D.page.iCycles, giving an epic c:P -> page cycles, with projection a:P -> A and a x pi = c iCycles.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed formulas for Z_r and B_r before lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex

proof.text: Precompose D.on_representatives by a. The pullback equation and iCycles_d imply (a y) followed by the target page quotient is zero. Apply the representative correction to a t,a tprime,a x,a y. This gives an epic e:B -> P and z into successor graded cycles with the same source graded class as e a x.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed formulas for Z_r and B_r before lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex

proof.text: Cancel the monomorphism from graded r-cycles to the graded piece to obtain z followed by hZ = e a x. Postcompose with the page quotient and use hf and the pullback equation. Cancel iCycles to obtain z f = e c. Since e and c are epic, Mathlib epi_of_epi_fac proves Epi f.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_successor_cycles_cover_epi
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (D : FilteredComplexPageDifferential K F r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hZ : F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) ≤
      F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) r)
    (f : (F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) : C) ⟶ D.page.cycles pq)
    (hf : f ≫ D.page.iCycles pq =
      Subobject.ofLE _ _ hZ ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K F r pq) : Epi f
